body:
Clean, focused fix with solid test coverage. All tests pass locally.

**Summary of changes:**
1. Switches `git diff` from two-dot (`..`) to three-dot (`...`) syntax in `git-operations.ts`, ensuring changesets and changed-file detection align with GitHub’s PR diff semantics. This eliminates false-positive changeset failures when `main` advances after a PR’s merge ref is created.
2. Adds `hasKumoChanges` gating to `validate-pr-description.ts` so a changeset is only demanded when `packages/kumo/` is actually modified.
3. Adds an integration-level test in `git-operations.test.ts` that reproduces the stale-merge-ref scenario in a fresh repo and asserts the correct isolation.
4. Wires both test files into their respective CI workflows so regressions are caught early.

Everything looks correct and minimal. Approving.
